key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) reformulates policy mirror descent for terminal-reward LLM training into a trajectory-level objective, avoiding intermediate state-value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a critic-free reinforcement learning approach for reasoning-focused LLMs that can be simpler to implement and potentially more stable than value-based methods.
method: Derive a trajectory-level objective from the Bellman equations for autoregressive generation with terminal rewards.
Approximate the objective to obtain a practical BPO loss without estimating intermediate state values.
Use a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities as the mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing BPO is effective for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: The practical performance may depend on the quality of the approximation and the stability of the mismatch-correction weighting in long autoregressive sequences.
